feeding_claim.verbatim: They are 100% grass fed from birth to butcher.

certifications.evidence_note: Matched to USDA record "Sky Valley Family Farm" (Sultan, WA), pasture or hay certified; livestock not certified, in the Organic Integrity snapshot of 2026-10-01.

farmers_markets: Tonnemaker's Woodinville Farm Stand (1st and 3rd Saturdays, November to April)
notes: Farm store open daily 9am to 8pm, with next-day pre-order pickup through the web store. Eggs are also carried by home delivery services (Pacific Coast Harvest, New Roots Organics, Farm Fresh Northwest, Salmonberry Goods). Pigs are supplemented with non-GMO grains on pasture. Site says fields are certified organic; organic label left to the matcher.
